taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: Gate-C eval with FIXED metrics (commit 04a2d3b): (1) yaw_drift now uses body-frame yaw angular velocity (deg/s) instead of abs heading accumulation (iter-11 found the old 177deg reading was a metric defect, physically inconsistent with good vx/lateral tracking); (2) per-episode step budget anti-hang so a stuck-but-not-terminated env[0] cannot stall the eval for hours (TASK_049/059 hung between seeds). Reports jp_err(analytic) vs jp_err(expert) + correct yaw_drift + dof_viol + base_pitch/height. max_iterations=1500 budget-safe. Trains x1_amp seed5 4096 envs fixed Gate-B expert.
